notes.title: Diddy Mini Update
notes.content:
First Update Notes 🎉

Hello Diddy Players! 👋

Thanks to your valuable feedback after the game's release, we identified a few issues and quickly rolled out a mini update. As the development team, while the lack of Chaos and Fun in the game might have pleased our lawyers 😅, we know it's not enough. That’s why hearing your suggestions for what you'd like to see or have fixed in the game would make us so happy!

We’re aware the game didn’t fully meet your expectations; honestly, we couldn’t entirely deliver what we wanted either... to avoid going to jail 💀​. But don’t worry! With the major update coming in 1 month, we’ll make Diddy a much better game! 🚀

Fixed Bugs 🛠️:

Friendly NPCs mistakenly perceiving players as enemies.
Enemy health bars not decreasing despite taking damage.
Optimization issues resolved.
Added helpful details for players.
Rebalanced item prices and adjusted their availability.
Thank you for your support! More to come soon! 💥

— Gverse Team 🎮
